source: config.json of each repository on the HuggingFace hub, main revision, read 2026-09-06 (the local model directory belongs to the service account and is not readable from the measuring account)
kv_bytes_per_token_f16: full-attention layers x kv heads x head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes; linear-attention and Mamba layers hold a fixed-size state per sequence instead

mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-Next-4bit.other_layers: gated DeltaNet linear attention (constant state per sequence)

mlx-community/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightn.other_layers: Mamba-2 (23, constant state per sequence) and MoE (23)

mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-8bit.other_layers: none; multi-head latent attention (kv_lora_rank 512, rope dim 64) on every layer

mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-8bit.other_layers: gated DeltaNet linear attention (48, constant state per sequence); no MoE, every parameter active

weights_bytes_on_disk: the model directory's size as the control panel's state endpoint reports it
